title: Chess, But You Can't Capture Pieces...
summary: Chess where no piece may capture (either side); checks still count and the game is won by checkmate. Four games: Martin (250), Smartin (???, Martin with glasses), then a new evil black-faced Martin (the strongest iteration) twice (win + rematch).
rules: Normal piece movement but no piece may capture another piece (both sides).
Check still applies: a king in check must move/block; win by checkmate (2:04 Qe8#, 5:24 Qd7#, 7:34 e5#).
No swap rule: the purple boxes/arrows are the narrator's analysis marks.
